{{Quote|I think we almost met a few days ago—my comm and computer guy Thaymes spotted Myri a couple of times, flirted with her in a bar, but thought she was just an unusually adventuresome nester.|Sharr Latt to Voort saBinring|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Nester''' was the title given to the locals of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]] that targeted [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Soldier/Legends|troopers]] stationed on the planet's army base for [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] as a way to leave the world.<ref name="MK" />
